name: Constellation
notion: A matrix is just two arrows: where î lands and where ĵ lands.

tiers.banner: The stars of (1, 0) and (0, 1) are given: place î and ĵ on them
NEW RULE · TWO OTHER STARS — deduce î and ĵ from them
NEW RULE · STAR MAP ONLY — read the matrix

story.intro: The night sky lost its map and the stars drifted. Move î and ĵ to put every star back.
story.cleared: The sky is mapped again. A matrix is where î and ĵ land, and every star follows.
